charts.label: tromso
charts.why: beyond the polar circle: Placidus undefined, substitution expected
charts.house_system_note: placidus is undefined at latitude 69.6492 (beyond the polar circle no ecliptic point crosses the horizon, so there is no diurnal arc to divide); using porphyry, which keeps cusp 1 = Asc and cusp 10 = MC. The four angles are unaffected.
